grouping_rule.R0: consecutive lifecycles of one item <= 24 h apart
grouping_rule.R1: duplicate_of: duplicate lifecycle to the parent lifecycle nearest in time
grouping_rule.R2: identical normalised root_cause, spans within 7 days
grouping_rule.R3: alert-class nodes within 32 min (30 + 2 poll jitter) sharing source family or repo
grouping_rule.R4: items with the same repo within 32 min
grouping_rule.R5: same fix commit/PR (first 100 chars of a closing note, or merge columns) cited by <= 8 items, spans within 7 days
grouping_rule.node: lifecycle segment of an item (split at every transition back into new) or an event without an item
grouping_rule.order: R3, R4 (time proximity, spread <= 8 h, chronic items skipped) then R1, R0, R2, R5 (identity)
grouping_rule.signal_time: events.first_seen or the Slack message time when it lies within 6 h before first_seen; older lifecycles: creation/reopen transition
